findings.summary: New exam creation still defaults show_score_to_student to checked (visible), violating the 'default tersembunyi' requirement.
findings.evidence: <input type="checkbox" name="show_score_to_student" checked …> — the 'checked' attribute means every new exam is created with score visible to students. The route stores the value as: show_score_to_student ? true : false, so unchecked = false = hidden is what is needed.
findings.consequence: Every new exam will show scores to students immediately upon submission. The teacher must manually toggle it hidden after creation, which is not the approved default behavior.
findings.correction: Remove the 'checked' attribute from the show_score_to_student checkbox in exam_new.ejs and update the tip text to state that scores are hidden by default.
